$comment: The Microsoft Store listing's own facts (PKG-12, D-202). The words people read come from the product site, so the two never disagree: the description, short description and first features from site/landing.json, the privacy statement from site/privacy.md. tools/release/store-listing.mjs writes store/listing.en-US.md from both; pnpm check fails when it's stale. Partner Center takes the listing by hand at the first submission (documentations/plan/microsoft-store.md). Draft until WP-10.5 writes the site's final words.
siteOnly: Pick a swatch to see one.
about: Every note is a Markdown file in a folder you choose. Sign in with your own GitHub account and Focus Notes backs your notes up to your own repository, or keep them on this computer only.
Free and open source, under the MIT License.
features: Works offline: notes are plain files on your computer, backed up to your own GitHub repository when you're online.
Private notes stay in your own private repository; share a sealed copy with only the people you choose.
A command-line tool and an MCP server, so the agents you allow can read and write notes, each change kept and undoable.
systemRequirements: Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or Windows 11, on a 64-bit (x64) PC.
certificationNotes: No account is needed to test the app: on the first screen choose "Just use this computer for now" and start writing; notes are saved as Markdown files in Documents\Focus Notes. Signing in to GitHub is optional and only backs notes up to the tester's own repository. Closing the window keeps Focus Notes running in the notification area, so it opens again at once; right-click its icon there and choose "Quit Focus Notes" to quit. The app declares runFullTrust because it's a desktop (Electron) app, the focus-notes: link scheme to open a note from a link, and the focus-notes command-line alias.

screenshots.required: PNG, 1366 × 768 to 3840 × 2160 pixels, landscape, up to 10, each under 50 MB. At least one.

captions.files-light: Your notes are files in folders you choose.
captions.themes-light: Pick a theme and see the whole page change at once.
captions.setup-welcome: Start with your own GitHub account, or keep your notes on this computer only.
captions.setup-connect: Sign in once with the GitHub account you already use.
captions.setup-create: Focus Notes makes two repositories of your own: one for public notes, one for private ones.
captions.setup-creating: Every step of the setup shows as it happens.
captions.setup-backup: Notes back up to your own GitHub repository in the background, and you can see when.

screenshots.source: The files in store/screenshots/: 2560 × 1440 PNGs of the app's window at 1120 × 720, drawn at twice the scale, on a plain backdrop; the cascade lays four windows over each other. They're generated, never taken by hand: `gh workflow run review-captures.yml -f catalog=store` captures the scenes on CI, then `python tools/release/store-screenshots.py --captures <the fetched folder>` makes the PNGs (D-223).
